# Founders Doc

> Founders Doc is a legal practice for founders and start-ups, founded in Singapore in 2021, advising early-stage companies around the world. FD AI is its online drafting tool: answer a few questions and FD AI drafts a legal document from Founders Doc's own lawyer-written masters, ready as a Word document in minutes. A practising lawyer is one click away. Anyone can start free.

## FD AI — draft a document

- [Draft a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)](https://foundersdoc.com/draft?type=nondisclosureagreement): mutual or one-way NDA for founders
- [All documents FD AI drafts](https://foundersdoc.com/draft): term sheets, employment and contractor agreements, shareholders', share purchase and share subscription agreements, investment, loan, convertible loan, services, IP assignment and joint venture agreements
- [Pricing](https://foundersdoc.com/pricing): start free with 3 documents over 14 days (no card), then S$8.80 a document or a membership from S$18.80 a month (SGD)

## Free templates (drafted by FD AI)

- [All templates](https://foundersdoc.com/templates)
- [NDA template](https://foundersdoc.com/templates/nda): Keep what you share private — mutual or one-way, under the law you choose. Also: NDA for Singapore (https://foundersdoc.com/templates/nda/singapore), NDA for UK (https://foundersdoc.com/templates/nda/uk), NDA for US (https://foundersdoc.com/templates/nda/us), Mutual NDA (https://foundersdoc.com/templates/nda/mutual), One-way NDA (https://foundersdoc.com/templates/nda/one-way), NDA for Malaysia (https://foundersdoc.com/templates/nda/malaysia), NDA for Hong Kong (https://foundersdoc.com/templates/nda/hong-kong), NDA for Australia (https://foundersdoc.com/templates/nda/australia), NDA for India (https://foundersdoc.com/templates/nda/india)
- [Employment contract template](https://foundersdoc.com/templates/employment-contract): Hire in any country: probation, notice, IP, confidentiality and restrictions. Also: Employment contract for Singapore (https://foundersdoc.com/templates/employment-contract/singapore)
- [Loan agreement template](https://foundersdoc.com/templates/loan-agreement): Lend or borrow money with clear repayment, interest and security terms
- [Shareholders' agreement template](https://foundersdoc.com/templates/shareholders-agreement): How the company is run, and what happens when shareholders join, sell or leave
- [Contractor agreement template](https://foundersdoc.com/templates/contractor-agreement): Engage a freelancer or consultant: scope, fees, IP and how it ends
- [Services agreement template](https://foundersdoc.com/templates/services-agreement): Sell or buy a software subscription or professional services
